effects.printed_clause: When an Aldrez battles, opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards or effects through the Damage Step.
effects.lua_implementation: Field CANNOT_ACTIVATE effect is live while attacker or battle target is own face-up Aldrez and blocks opponent Spell/Trap active types.

official_references.card_name: Ancient Warriors Saga - Defense of Changban
official_references.matched_structure: Field effect suppresses opponent Spell/Trap activations while an archetype monster battles through the Damage Step.

effects.printed_clause: Main Phase: reveal hand Aldrez or target controlled Aldrez; Special Summon a different-name Aldrez from hand/banishment with the same Link/non-Link type. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition selects from hand or field, reveals/shuffles hand or targets field appropriately, records code and Link status, then Special Summons a face-up banished/hand different-name match; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Reveal/record a card characteristic and later select a matching summon candidate.

coverage_override.reason: The battle-time Spell/Trap activation lock is one continuous effect, while the reveal-or-target and same-Type Special Summon procedure plus HOPT form one activated effect.
